_about: Owner: batch S2 (tours/life-of-a-request, reference/afd-config). Search all glossary files before you add a term; reuse ids from core.json and s1.json.

ffn-server-loop.short: The connector-driven daemon thread on the FFN worker. It waits for DP metadata, then runs the FFN compute for one step. No scheduler drives it.
ffn-server-loop.long: Started in AFDFFNWorker.start_ffn_server_loop ({{cite afd_plugin/v1/worker/ffn_worker.py:133}}); the loop body is _run_ffn_server_loop ({{cite afd_plugin/v1/worker/ffn_worker.py:160}}).

dp-metadata.short: The per-step data-parallel metadata the attention side sends to the FFN side on the control plane. It carries the per-stage token counts that set the tensor shapes.

connector-extra-config.short: A mapping of connector-specific options inside the AFD config. Each connector declares which keys it accepts, and rejects the rest.
connector-extra-config.long: Parsed by each connector's parse_extra_config class method ({{cite afd_plugin/connectors/base.py:64-72}}).

rendezvous.short: The host and port where the two roles meet to set up the connector process groups. Both servers use the same host and port.
rendezvous.long: The connector opens a TCP store at host:port ({{cite afd_plugin/connectors/gpu/p2p.py:271}}).
